name: badge

source.prompt: One unusually realistic shop-owner ID pass on a dark woven lanyard, including top hanging loop, stainless spring clip, clear polycarbonate sleeve, white printed card showing a single small black-and-white headshot of a Kurdish man with short hair. No lettering or simulated words. Front view, almost upright. Lanyard forms narrow inverted elongated V above card, centered so pivot is top center.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
